state.case_1: Edition A has reserved code alpha. Edition A has committed its accepted rename to alpha and references the exact reservation token. A network timeout loses the acknowledgement. The coordinator releases A reservation before re-reading or fencing the target. Edition B then reserves alpha successfully. Both A accepted rename fact and B reservation now exist.
state.case_2: Operation X on an absent criterion receives a no-fact refusal. Coordinator treats the response as terminal and releases X without recording any token fence in the criterion stream. Later the criterion becomes eligible and a delayed copy of X arrives.
state.case_3: A pending creation/rename reservation must not be released after the target accepted it. Confirming a label claim requires the target acceptance fact. The sequence is reserve claim, target commits transition using that reservation, confirm claim, release old claim.

case_1_simultaneous_claims.instructions: In case_1, are both an accepted rename to alpha for edition A and a reservation for alpha by edition B recorded at the same time?

case_1_unknown_release.instructions: In case_1, did the coordinator release the reservation without first knowing whether edition A accepted?

case_2_delayed_write.instructions: In case_2, can the delayed copy of X become an accepted structural write, absent a target-side token fence?

case_3_order.instructions: In case_3, can the claim be confirmed before the target has committed its acceptance fact?
